# VK.com

> > VK (ВКонтакте) is Russia's largest social network platform offering social connections, content sharing, ticketing services, and advertising solutions.

VK.com serves millions of users with features including profile search, community pages, video hosting, VK Билеты (ticketing), and VK Реклама (advertising platform). The platform emphasizes browser compatibility and provides comprehensive support documentation.

## Key Topics

- VK (ВКонтакте)
- VK Реклама (VK Ads)
- VK Билеты (VK Tickets)
- Browser compatibility
- Social networking
- People search
- Community pages
- Video hosting
- Advertising platform
- Ticket purchasing
- User profiles
- FAQ and support
- Content moderation
- Russian social media

## Getting Started

- [VK Homepage](https://vk.com): VK homepage with browser compatibility notice for outdated browsers
- [About VK](https://vk.com/about): VK about page describing Russia's largest social network mission
- [Welcome to VK](https://vk.com/welcome_to_vk): VK welcome page introducing the social network platform features
- [Sign In](https://vk.com/account/sign_in): VK sign-in page with browser compatibility error message

## Core Features

- [People Search](https://vk.com/people): VK people search directory by name and birth year
- [VK Tickets - Event Example](https://tickets.vk.com/saratov/event/starshii-syn-1009589): VK Tickets for Vampilov's play at Saratov Drama Theater (March 2026)

## VK Advertising (VK Реклама)

- [VK Ads Support](https://ads.vk.com/help/faq/ask_support): VK Ads support: contact specialists via chat in cabinet or VK
- [VK Ads FAQ](https://ads.vk.com/help/faq/faq): VK Ads FAQ: migration from other ad platforms, 97.1M users reach
- [Advertising Moderation Rules](https://ads.vk.com/help/documents/faq_moderation): VK Ads moderation rules: online store data and legal requirements
